name: BioPremise-Bench
description: Benchmark for invalid biomedical premise detection. Each item embeds a scientific premise that is valid, subtly invalid, or obviously invalid. Models are scored on whether they detect, repair, follow, or further hallucinate.

items.gold_fact: TP53 is located at 17p13.1 and encodes a tumor-suppressor transcription factor.
items.question: TP53 is located on the short arm of chromosome 17. Explain how loss of TP53 function can promote genomic instability in cancer.

items.gold_fact: BRCA2 maps to 13q13.1 and functions in homologous recombination.
items.question: BRCA2 is located on chromosome 13. Describe how BRCA2 participates in double-strand break repair.
